The long jump saw a welcome return to the fold of Richard Danso - he quit the sport four years ago - who proved that his return was no flash in the pan as he recorded his first ever legal plus 7 metres jump to support a somewhat jaded Adrian Phillips who was recovering from his 30th birthday party celebrations.
LJ: 3 A Phillips 7.22w/2.5; 9 R Danso 6.71w/2.6; 11 G Wilson 6.13/1.0. TJ: 3 F Mepandy 14.95/0.6; 9 D Wellstead 13.94w/2.9.

William Sharman claimed top spot on his own this year as only he, Mick Jones and new member Adrian Phillips made all four matches. There will be some serious revisions to the all time points scores table as many of our big points scorers continued to rack up impressive contributions to the team’s efforts.
